d: 🚀 Business Development Assistant / Business Development Coordinator / Business Development Executive
Job Level: Business Development / Commercial Operations

We are seeking a proactive, ambitious, and results-oriented professional to support business growth, develop client relationships, and identify new commercial opportunities. The ideal candidate will contribute to business development initiatives, coordinate sales activities, maintain client relationships, and support the organization in achieving its strategic growth objectives.
Identify and research potential clients, business opportunities, and new market segments.
Support the development and execution of business growth strategies.
Build and maintain positive relationships with existing and prospective clients.
Coordinate meetings, presentations, business proposals, and follow-up activities.
Assist in preparing quotations, proposals, contracts, and business reports.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify industry trends.
Collaborate with sales, marketing, and operations teams to support business initiatives.
Follow up on leads, enquiries, and potential business partnerships.
Maintain accurate client databases, sales records, and business development documentation.
Monitor business development activities and provide regular progress updates.
Support networking events, client meetings, and promotional activities.
Identify opportunities to improve client engagement and business performance.

Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Good understanding of business development and client relationship management.
Ability to identify opportunities and conduct market research.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and business communication tools.
Confidence in communicating with clients and business partners.

Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with a team.

We are seeking a dynamic Marketing Specialist to join a well-established organisation in Muscat, Oman, specialising in asset-backed financing and transportation (marine vessels, aircraft, and vehicles). This is a full-time, on-site position offering the opportunity to strengthen the company’s brand, support business development, and enhance engagement with international clients and partners.

As Marketing Specialist, you will plan and execute marketing activities, manage digital presence, create high-quality content and promotional materials, coordinate events, and analyse marketing performance in a fast-paced international business environment. This is a hands-on Marketing Manager to build the marketing function and strategy from scratch, execute the work themselves, represent the company at forums, and work closely with business departments.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field.
2–4 years of relevant experience in marketing, digital marketing, communications, or brand management.
Experience in an international or corporate business environment is preferred.
Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and presentation skills.
Practical experience managing websites, social media platforms, and digital campaigns.
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
Good analytical and reporting skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Creativity, initiative, strong organisational skills, and attention to detail.
Professional working proficiency in English (mandatory); additional languages (French, Spanish, Arabic) are an advantage.
r: li
Prepare marketing activity schedules, budgets, and campaign plans aligned with business objectives.
li
Manage and regularly update the Company’s website and prepare content for the website, newsletters, presentations, brochures, and advertisements.
li
Develop corporate profiles, marketing presentations, promotional materials, and customer communications.
li
Ensure consistent application of the Company’s brand identity, visual guidelines, tone of voice, and quality standards across all channels.
li
Coordinate the Company’s participation in exhibitions, conferences, seminars, and corporate events.
li
Support the organisation of customer meetings, networking events, and promotional activities, including preparation of invitations, banners, and branded items.
li
Prepare corporate announcements, press materials, and proposals for potential customers and business partners.
li
Track marketing campaigns, prepare monthly/quarterly reports, analyse results against KPIs, and recommend improvements.
li
Maintain an organised library of approved marketing assets, logos, templates, and promotional materials.
li
Liaise with internal departments, designers, agencies, printers, and external suppliers.

d: We are currently seeking a passionate and dynamic Sales Executive to focus on our Residences business, specifically managing long-stay guests and long-term accommodation enquiries. As a Sales Executive, you will be responsible for implementing all sales activities and maximizing business opportunities within your designated market segment under the guidance and supervision of the Director of Sales. The role involves generating and maintaining business through proactive sales efforts, including face-to-face meetings, client presentations, telephone calls, and networking activities.
q: You should hold preferably a degree in sales marketing and minimum two years post graduate work experience in a similar position. Good computer skills and a perfect command of English is required.
The ideal candidate will be a vibrant and innovative individual.

You will be able to work independently and promote at all times the brand image and market status, as well as maintain accurate documentation and accounts record on all clients assigned, while possessing the following additional competencies
r: li
Handle all long-term accommodation enquiries for Beach Rotana Residences, from initial inquiry through to contract completion and move-in coordination.
li
Develop and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, government organizations, relocation agencies, and individual guests seeking extended-stay accommodation.
li
Promote and sell long-stay and residential accommodation solutions to achieve occupancy and revenue targets.
li
Maintain a high level of market presence through direct sales activities and client visits.
li
Ensure comprehensive coverage of assigned accounts and market segments, building relationships at all levels of client organizations.
li
Implement and execute sales action plans to achieve and exceed established targets.
li
Negotiate rates, contracts, and long-term accommodation agreements in line with the property's sales strategy.
li
Identify and maximize upselling opportunities whenever possible.
li
Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Beach Rotana Residences' facilities, apartment types, services, amenities, and unique selling points.
li
Prepare proposals, corporate offers, lease agreements, and other business correspondence as required.
li
Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer needs, providing regular feedback and recommendations to management.
li
Ensure exceptional customer service throughout the guest journey, fostering long-term relationships and repeat business
